dogecoin.text:
#Bitcoin is no #Dogecoin, but over the past few month's the largest crypto-asset's price movements have been increasingly correlated with Elon Musk's tweets.

In our latest research newsletter, we dive into the latest crash:

https://t.co/ERsQb5eb7K

$DOGE price and volumes surged to multi month highs last week after Tesla CEO @elonmusk reached a $44bn deal to take over $TWTR. The acquisition boosted hopes for the coin's use cases, as Musk has openly expressed his support for DOGE over the past year. https://t.co/Jh4fchnW9r
